findings.title: Distinct integer request semantics collide in idempotency fingerprint
findings.input: Create valid project, accepted Requirement and Goal using existing test fixture. First createTask stop_policy.wall_time_seconds=9007199254740992. Repeat same Idempotency-Key and If-Match with only that integer changed to 9007199254740993.

observations.test_failure: REPRODUCED: semantically distinct integer input accepted as same idempotent request

findings.observation_provenance: Observed in functions.exec tool result chunk 809bfc during this review. Raw stdout/stderr files were not retained; these are transcript-derived observations, not reconstructed raw execution output.
findings.mechanism: StopPolicy integers have a minimum but no maximum; Decode preserves raw json.Number and Num distinguishes these int64 values, while Hash canonicalizes through IEEE754 and collapses them. Handler therefore treats a semantically different request as a replay.
findings.probe_source_use: Exact test function used in the executed overlay, appended to internal/domain/domain_test.go. Existing file supplied package, encoding/json/testing imports and setup helpers. Not a standalone go test file.
findings.isolation: HTTP handler via httptest and temporary SQLite; synthetic credential only; overlay and fixture temporary directories removed; no source edits or provider calls.
findings.expected: Different accepted integer semantics must not silently replay the first request; preserve semantic uniqueness or reject values not represented losslessly by the chosen canonical number semantics.
findings.follow_up: Owner fix and actual API regression pending; do not modify frozen schema thresholds merely to hide the failure.

findings.title: Historical CURRENT artifact can feed a new effective change after becoming STALE
findings.scenario: Artifact revision 1 is CURRENT, later revision 2 is marked STALE. Submit revision-1/hash as proposed_value_artifact_ref for a new ChangeProposal.
findings.observed_logic: artifactJSON loads the historical version and checks only its historical validity=CURRENT, PROJECT classification and sealed-byte hash. It does not check current effective(ref). Both proposal creation and final check use artifactJSON; historical reference storage is allowed.
findings.consequence: Historical bytes can become a proposed current value despite the current artifact having been invalidated.
findings.expected: Retain historical readability while separately enforcing current effective input eligibility before accepting/applying changes.
findings.execution_limit: No independent runtime reproduction performed for this finding.

findings.title: Profile facts and intent copied into ContextBundle lack semantic dependency tracking
findings.scenario: Ordinary Task refers only to a Requirement and has no Task-to-ProjectProfile ImpactLink. Its ContextBundle copies Profile facts F1 and intent. An accepted change updates Profile facts to F2.
findings.observed_logic: Bundle version_vector contains Task requirement_refs/input_refs and two policy refs, while profile facts/intent are copied without a corresponding version dependency. Impact closure follows explicit links; taskContext checks only its vector and policy_revision.
findings.consequence: The task may retain an apparently valid bundle containing F1 after a real consumed input changed to F2.
findings.expected: Track semantic dependencies for profile content actually included in the bundle without globally invalidating unrelated Tasks on arbitrary ProjectState revisions.
findings.execution_limit: No independent runtime reproduction performed for this finding.
